notes: Section headings no longer carry icons. The theme does not use them there, and it now says so itself rather than the app deciding — a theme that wants heading icons simply leaves that out.
Icons inside buttons take the colour of the button’s own text. On the gold primary button the icon was rendering white against a light fill, which was hard to read.
The Control Panel window opens smaller, matching the tighter spacing of the current theme. It can still be dragged smaller than before if you want it out of the way.
